    • issue

      public boolean issue(UUID credentialId, String tokenHash, Instant now, Instant expiresAt, Duration resendInterval)
      Description copied from interface: EmailLinkTokenRepository
      Issues a token for the credential with one atomic upsert, which is also the resend limit: an existing token younger than resendInterval is left untouched.
      Specified by:
      issue in interface EmailLinkTokenRepository
      Parameters:
      credentialId - the email credential
      tokenHash - the SHA-256 hash of the token value
      now - the current time
      expiresAt - when the token expires
      resendInterval - the minimum age of an existing token before it may be replaced
      Returns:
      true if a row changed, meaning the link should be sent
